class.name: AdapterDataObserver
class.description: AdapterDataObserver is the port of [i]RecyclerView.AdapterDataObserver[/i]. Register an instance on an [b]Adapter[/b] via [method Adapter.register_adapter_data_observer] and override the [code]_on_*[/code] hooks to react to data changes. The RecyclerView uses one internally to stay in sync with the adapter.

method.name: _on_changed
method.description: Called when the whole data set changed.

method.name: _on_item_range_changed
method.description: Called when items changed content (with an optional payload).

method.name: _on_state_restoration_policy_changed
method.description: Called when the state restoration policy changed.
